zh: 另一台电脑可以当「运行机」（Beta）：上面的客户端都用这台的 FULI，记忆只存一份。
每段对话都记下是哪个客户端、哪个会话、什么模型写的，读记录时逐条可查。
开任务快了将近一半；客户端卡片列全六项，缺什么一眼看出。
en: Another computer can be a runner (Beta): its clients use this FULI, with one memory.
Each conversation records the client, session and model that wrote it, message by message.
Task entry is nearly twice as fast; client tiles list all six parts, so gaps show.
